posts.title: How to tell if your battery is really dying

slides.text:
How to tell if your battery is really dying
Check Settings > Battery > Battery Health

Check Settings > Battery > Battery Health
Under 85% means meaningful capacity is gone
Watch which app sits at 40%+ in battery usage
A rogue location app drains more than screen
Restart weekly to clear silent background hogs
Save this — insider knowledge only pays off when you use it.

Delete the biggest offline videos and games first
Offload apps you haven't opened in months
Check again in a week — it stays under control.
